summary: North American Construction Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, announcing an amendment and expansion of its existing five-year contract with a metallurgical coal producer in Queensland, Australia. The expanded contract, which runs through September 30, 2029, adds approximately $125 million in incremental revenue and increases scope by 50%. The expansion includes additional fully maintained equipment, with eight haul trucks already purchased and five more to be acquired at an estimated cost of ~$25 million in Q2/Q3 2026. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
